title: ObjectDB Profiler freezes when GDScript files have complex circular preload references
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.7.3) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Max (Apple8) - Apple M2 Max (12 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When a project contains multiple GDScript files that mutually reference each other via `preload()` (circular dependencies), clicking "Take ObjectDB Snapshot" in the Debugger's ObjectDB Profiler causes the editor to freeze.

The reproduction project has 20 GDScript files (`script_1.gd` through `script_20.gd`), each of which `preload()`s all 20 scripts (including itself). A root script (`root.gd`) preloads `script_1.gd` and is attached to the main scene node. When the game is run from the editor and the ObjectDB Profiler snapshot is requested, the editor becomes unresponsive and must be force-quit.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached minimal reproduction project in Godot 4.6.1
2. Run Project
3. In the editor, go to the **Debugger** panel at the bottom
4. Switch to the **ObjectDB Profiler** tab (labeled "ObjectDB" in the debugger tabs)
5. Click the **Take ObjectDB Snapshot** button
6. Observe that the editor freezes and becomes unresponsive

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[objectdb-with-complex-refs-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26171425/objectdb-with-complex-refs-mrp.zip)
